title: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate

entities.name: Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate
entities.description: Information element that carries APN-AMBR values from network to UE for uplink policy enforcement when values exceed the maximum specified in the regular APN-AMBR IE.

entities.name: APN aggregate maximum bit rate
entities.description: Regular APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element defined in clause 9.9.4.2 with specified maximum values.

entities.name: APN-AMBR values exceed maximum
entities.description: Condition where at least one APN-AMBR value to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the regular APN-AMBR IE.

entities.name: Network wishes to transmit APN-AMBR values
entities.description: Condition where the network intends to send APN-AMBR values to the UE for uplink policy enforcement.

relations.description: Extended APN-AMBR IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that network wishes to transmit APN-AMBR values for uplink policy enforcement.
Extended APN-AMBR IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that at least one APN-AMBR value exceeds the maximum specified in the regular APN-AMBR IE.
The maximum value condition is defined relative to the regular APN-AMBR IE specifications.
